tagline: A residential HVAC and plumbing service company with a membership base
overview: Project Ember is a residential heating, cooling and plumbing company in Ontario. It installs and services equipment for homeowners, with a maintenance membership that brings customers back every season and a trained team of technicians and comfort advisors.

highlights.title: Membership base
highlights.detail: A maintenance club brings repeat service visits through the year.

highlights.title: Trained technicians
highlights.detail: Licensed technicians handle service and installation in-house.

highlights.title: Balanced work
highlights.detail: Service, repair and replacement work smooth out the seasons.

highlights.title: Equipped fleet
highlights.detail: Stocked service vans keep jobs to one visit.

whoItSuits: An HVAC operator adding a region
transition: The owner offers a 6-month handover through the heating season
